records.definition: Cryptographic attribution/integrity for exact evidence. It grants no Access Control or method Permission.
Coarse authority to cross a protected domain boundary: permission to enter the building.
Exact authority for a subject to invoke a specific method on a specific object after Security Effect evaluation.
The enforcement point that prevents protected operations when policy returns deny. It consumes Permission decisions but does not become PermissionAuthority.
Independent semantic assessment bound into PermissionRequest; Permission consumes its disposition, policy identity, trace identity, and constraints.
In-process admission state created after Access Control ALLOW, pinned to the exact admission-policy identity and guarded before protected METHOD evaluation.
Cryptographic evidence that a particular Access Control or Permission decision is authentic. It is not a bearer capability.
Resolver for a sealed fixed policy or live Institutional Policy catalog policy at an exact authorization time.
When matching rules have equal priority and mixed actions, DENY wins. Same-action ties use lexical rule id.

provenance.claim: Core glossary terms derive from the project separation of authentication attribution, Access Control, Permissions and Security Manager enforcement.
